claim: Five public mnemonic.spec.ts vectors independently provide 24 English words and expected Ed25519 secretKey. Fixture retains zero-based dictionary indices and the first 32 bytes of each published secretKey (seed). Offline standard-library HMAC/PBKDF2 checks those published seeds and the basic-seed predicate; it does not test Ed25519 public keys or addresses. Reviewed 2026-09-29; byte SHA-256 ba6936664624168caf454df777b4ef8354c034c49b121a493c44237e4880cd83. See docs/research/batches/bip39-ton.md.
